{{Otheruses|Qiraash}}
'''Qiraash''' was a location from which the [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]] builder of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], [[Doffen Gaitag]], originated.<ref name="VSV">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-1|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Qiraash was first mentioned in ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] and published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]]. The article does not make clear what, if any, the connection between the location Qiraash and the [[Species/Legends|species]] of the same name is and also does not give context to what sort of location Qiraash is.
